title: A Novel Bijective Angle and Volume-preservation Balanced Parameterization for $n$-dimensional Manifolds
summary: We propose a unified framework for bijective parameterizations of $n$-dimensional manifolds that jointly control angular and volumetric distortion through a weighted combination of conformal and volume-preserving energies. A logarithmic barrier based on signed simplex Jacobians prevents element inversion and degeneration during energy minimization. On oriented simplicial manifolds, the gradients of all three discrete energies admit a unified cotangent Laplacian-type representation that preserves the sparsity of the mesh connectivity.
